### problem_chain

At opening: initial_state has no physdmg_total_loss_settlements table at all → no accepted surrender row for PD-2026-0822415. Unmet. The policy whose rule describes that state's write: S ("The surrender settlement is the net settlement a customer accepts when a total-loss vehicle and its title go to Cardinal"), tool accept_total_loss_settlement_c07cd979, owner user.
- S's rule: "The surrender settlement is fixed only after the claim carries an accepted coverage decision stating its deductible." At opening the only coverage decision rows are b5ed069a (claim PD-2025-0412066). Claim PD-2026-0822415 has report b3c0eee5, estimates a460b228 / 33b2b019, TL declaration c7781dff, fault ff157678 — no coverage decision. Unmet. Resolving write: A, record_claim_acceptance_ec9cfb06, owner agent.
- A's rule carries no prerequisite sentence; its inputs (claim report, fault row 2026-09-30, telematics enrollment, auto package, closed claims) are all present. Stop.
- Tree: A → S (value_input, decided_deductible), S → L (value_input, accepted_settlement / stated payoff / acceptance date). n = 2 prerequisite problems, value_input edges 2 ≥ max(1, 1). Customer's own write: S. No cycle. Topological order A, S, L.

Skip S → L has no accepted settlement/payoff to measure; L undefined. Both edges carry value.

## findings

C-1 SOURCE-CHAIN RED — persona names the prerequisite problems' subjects; closure assertion false.
- Symptom: user_scenario: "You have no idea how Cardinal works out settlements or deductibles and you don't try to guess at any figure." — an unconditional line naming the subjects of both prerequisite problems (the surrender settlement S and the coverage-decision deductible A).
- Root cause: the "don't guess" guard is written by naming the very quantities the agent is supposed to discover through the rules.
- Evidence: prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: "It never mentions a coverage decision, a deductible or a settlement before the agent raises them" — word-for-word contradicted by the persona sentence above, which is not conditioned on the agent raising anything.
- Demonstrated consequence: a simulator voicing that line ("I don't know how you work out the settlement or the deductible") tells the agent, before it has read L's rule, that a settlement and a deductible stand between the request and the payment — the two hops the task claims the agent must derive from the prerequisite sentences. The closure's proof that the tree is undisclosed does not hold.
- Affected: tasks/0.json user_scenario (paragraph 3, first sentence); prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint.
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

F-1…F-6 (charter-global, `_difficulty.md` § findings) — consequence on this world:
- F-1 repeat_claim_surcharge: +100.00 on the deductible from claim PD-2025-0412066; without it the decision is 225.00 (scored 275.00). The scored deductible rests on a treatment no carrier publishes.
- F-2 uninsured_driver_waiver: the only declared method of A is a 0.50 rate; A has no method factor here.
- F-3 deductible_rewards_weighting: the 1.25 multiplier (31,076.28 vs 31,113.78) is a number labelled method.
- F-4 package_custom_equipment_limit: this world takes the Premier tier (3,000 over the option's 1,500, 30,763.78 vs 31,113.78); the defect is the ladder's Premier/Preferred tiers on the $100/$250 options, not this world's figure.
- F-5 payoff_to_loss_date: the only declared method of L is a 0.5 % rate; L has no method factor here.
- F-6 option_seasoning / tenure_credit: the scored benefit 4,605.26 is 90 % of the 5,116.96 shortfall because the option was carried 3 months and the policy is 147 months old; under real loan/lease payoff practice the in-force option pays 5,116.96.

Observations carried from `_difficulty.md`: O-1 (Premier cap on the $750 option), O-2 (option_change row vs physdmg trigger list), O-3 (1,765 "larger of" deduction presumes the 2025 insured-paid repair went unrepaired), O-4, O-6, O-9, O-10.
Prerequisite realism (brief priority): edge S←A is real practice (coverage and deductible are fixed before a total-loss settlement is offered), though in practice coverage acceptance precedes the estimate and total-loss declaration that this claim file already carries (observation). Edge L←S is real in substance (the gap is measured against the settled amount); real desks issue the loan/lease payoff together with or after the settlement payment to the loss payee, which here still waits on the title — the charter releases the benefit on acceptance alone (observation, no scoring consequence).
